known.via: English Wikipedia "Dominio de Valdepusa" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A Vino de Pago in Malpica de Tajo, Toledo, which won its status in 2003. This is the highest tier of Spanish wine, requiring estate-grown grapes and an on-site winery. Allowed grapes are Cabernet Sauvignon, Graciano, Petit Verdot and Syrah.
